paragraphs: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts. The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.
Trajectory 筹集了 4500 万美元，旨在让非技术专家也能进行 AI 模型训练。这家成立仅一年的初创公司目前估值已达 3 亿美元。
